meta.name: runbook
meta.description: Write an operating runbook from the delivered system and verified procedures. Use when the customer team or a successor needs to operate without the original engineer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把已交付的系统整理成别人能照着独立运维的操作手册
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果系统要交给客户或接替者独立运维,却没人记下操作步骤。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a delivered system into an operating manual others can follow on their own
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're handing a system to a team or successor who must run it without you

howto.what: 根据已交付的系统和已验证的流程，编写一份运维手册（runbook），让客户团队或接手的人能独立操作，不必依赖原工程师。
howto.when: 当客户团队或接手人需要在没有原工程师的情况下操作系统时触发。

say.text: 根据现在这套已交付系统写一份运维手册
say.note: 按已验证流程整理成 runbook

say.text: 接手的人不熟悉，帮我写份操作手册
say.note: 产出给后续团队使用的手册

say.text: 把部署和验收步骤整理成 runbook
say.note: 会区分实现、验证、部署与验收

howto.what_en: Writes an operating runbook from the delivered system and verified procedures, so a customer team or a successor can operate it without the original engineer.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the customer team or a successor needs to operate the system without the original engineer.

say_en.text: Write an operating runbook from the delivered system.
say_en.note: Produces a runbook from verified procedures.

say_en.text: Draft an operations manual for whoever takes over.
Turn the deployment and acceptance steps into a runbook.
say_en.note: Keeps implementation, verification, deployment, acceptance distinct.
